concept: A good leader helps the group, they don't just tell everyone what to do
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character leads a group activity by helping and including everyone, instead of just bossing people around
exercise.reflection_prompt: What did the character do that made them a good leader instead of just bossy?
exercise.practice: Student names one way they could help a group they're part of

assessment.success_marker: student distinguishes helping-based leadership from just giving orders
